existing.name: Amar Mahal Orchha
existing.issue: OK — real heritage hotel overlooking Betwa + cenotaphs

replacement.name: Amar Mahal
replacement.tagline: Palace-style heritage hotel overlooking the Betwa river and the 14 Bundela cenotaphs — the terrace at sunset with the Chaturbhuj shikhara silhouetted against orange sky is Orchha's defining image. Tripadvisor 977 reviews.
replacement.address: Behind Cenotaphs, Betwa Riverside, Orchha 472246, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: MP Tourism Sheesh Mahal (inside Orchha Fort)
existing.issue: OK as a property (real, atmospheric, inside-fort), but mispriced as 'value' at ₹5-15k — Sheesh Mahal sits at ₹3-7k typically and the actual MPT value pick at Orchha is MPT Betwa Retreat (₹2-4k, Tripadvisor 4.6/5 across 730 reviews, higher-rated than Sheesh Mahal).

replacement.name: MPT Betwa Retreat
replacement.tagline: MP Tourism's Betwa-side property — Tripadvisor 4.6/5 across 730 reviews (higher than Sheesh Mahal). Cottages and AC tents on a riverside garden, multi-cuisine restaurant. Quieter than the inside-fort property; the MPT value pick.
replacement.address: Betwa River bank, Orchha 472246, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Bundela Context
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Bundela Context' as a boutique guesthouse near Raja Mahal/Jahangir Mahal is not verifiable on Tripadvisor, Booking, MMT. Listicle ghost. Replace with MPT Sheesh Mahal — the only hotel actually INSIDE the fort complex, walking distance to Raja Mahal, Jahangir Mahal and the cenotaphs.

replacement.name: MPT Sheesh Mahal (inside Orchha Fort)
replacement.tagline: MP Tourism's property INSIDE the Bundela fort complex — Tripadvisor 4.2/5 across 379 reviews. Basic rooms but you sleep within the same fortress walls where the Bundela kings did, with Jahangir Mahal a short walk. The most atmospheric hotel location in MP.
replacement.address: Inside Orchha Fort, Orchha 472246, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Betwa Riverside Camps
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Betwa Riverside Camps' as tent accommodation with bonfire dinners is not verifiable as a single property on Tripadvisor, MMT, or Booking. The closest real Orchha tent operation is MPT Betwa Retreat (cottages + AC tents) which is already in the value slot. Replace xfactor with Bundelkhand Riverside — the largest mid-luxury riverside property with the pool.

replacement.name: Bundelkhand Riverside
replacement.tagline: Riverside heritage-style 4-star with 38 rooms, landscaped gardens, outdoor pool, and a terrace facing the Betwa. Tripadvisor 558 reviews — the mid-luxury banquet-friendly Orchha property; book the river-facing rooms.
replacement.address: Betwa River, near old palace, Orchha 472246, Madhya Pradesh
